query: What is the current official pattern for creating a Supabase JS client for the installed major version?
content:
### Install Supabase JS SDK

Source: https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js/blob/master/README.md

Install the Supabase JavaScript client library using npm. This is the primary package for interacting with Supabase services.

```bash
npm install @supabase/supabase-js
```

--------------------------------

### Initialize Supabase Client

Source: https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js/blob/master/packages/core/supabase-js/README.md

Import the client and initialize it with your project URL and public key.

```js
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'

// Create a single supabase client for interacting with your database
const supabase = createClient('https://xyzcompany.supabase.co', 'your-publishable-key')
```

--------------------------------

### Install Supabase JS

Source: https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js/blob/master/packages/core/supabase-js/README.md

Install the library using npm.

```sh
npm install @supabase/supabase-js
```

--------------------------------

### Client initialization with createClient

Source: https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js/blob/master/packages/core/supabase-js/src/SupabaseClient.ts

Creates a Supabase client by calling `createClient()` with the project URL and anon/public API key. All subsequent database, auth, and realtime operations use this client instance.

```typescript
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'

// Create a single supabase client for interacting with your database
const supabase = createClient('https://xyzcompany.supabase.co', 'your-publishable-key')
```

--------------------------------

### Update Supabase JavaScript Dependencies

Source: https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js/blob/master/docs/MIGRATION.md

Commands to update your Supabase JavaScript SDK packages to the latest version. This ensures compatibility with Node.js 20+ and other recent changes.

```bash
npm install @supabase/supabase-js@latest
# or, per-package:
npm install @supabase/auth-js@latest
```
